title: Linear programming bounds for hyperbolic surfaces

sections.title: Ramanujan surfaces
sections.extract: hyperbolic surfaceMof finite area isRamanujanifλ 1(M)≥1/4. We will also say thatM isstrictly Ramanujanifλ 1(M)>1/4. Selberg’s eigenvalue conjecture [Sel65] states that all congruence covers of the modular curve are Ramanujan (hence such surfaces could also be calledSelberg). A related question is whether there exist closed Ramanujan surfaces in every genus (see [Mon15, Question 1.1] and [Wri20, Problem 10.4]).
